capabilities: Model, identify, estimate and refute; graphical causal mechanisms
decision: Wrap identification and refutation; require explicit estimand and graph version
limitation: Refutation failure is informative; passing refutations does not verify unmeasured-confounding assumptions
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: A named observed/latent graph, intervention variables, outcome and target population.
scientific_qualification.output: An identification expression, or a recorded identification failure; estimation is a separate operation.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: The supplied graph and intervention semantics are substantively justified; the selected identification algorithm applies to its graph class.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Keep graph and expression identities. A successful identify_effect call does not imply an available estimator for its returned expression. Do not reinterpret an unsupported expression as nonidentification.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use adjustment, front-door and nonidentified latent-IV witnesses; independently evaluate supported expressions on finite laws and verify unsupported-estimator status.

evidence.finding: identify_effect selects IDIdentifier for id-algorithm; estimate_effect requires a separate method and identified estimand.
